skills.purpose: Establish the tenant boundary, ProductTruth evidence, capability matrix and stop conditions before work begins.
skills.stopCondition: Stop if claim evidence, identity boundary, consent/data map or owner is missing.

skills.purpose: Turn approved sources and consented summaries into JTBD hypotheses without outreach or sensitive inference.
skills.stopCondition: Do not contact people, upload audiences or present a hypothesis as a market fact.

skills.purpose: Create a falsifiable value hypothesis that differentiates a designed product flow from generic AI without unsupported superiority claims.
skills.stopCondition: Block unverified product, commercial or comparative claims.

skills.purpose: Produce concept/copy packages in the tenant's required locales with provenance, accessibility direction and measurement definitions.
skills.stopCondition: Return internal drafts only; never self-approve, schedule, send or publish.

skills.purpose: Evaluate claims, privacy, safety, rights, localization, visual direction and operational traceability independently of the creator.
skills.stopCondition: Block every hard failure and do not advance an asset without a human decision.

skills.purpose: Define activation, repeat value, denominator and guardrails using aggregate, consent-scoped signals only.
skills.stopCondition: Do not collect or infer individual sensitive behavior.

skills.purpose: Prepare a channel package, approval envelope and rollback checklist without performing an external action.
skills.stopCondition: Stop before OAuth, scheduling, posting, sending, ad creation or spend.

skills.purpose: Turn bounded aggregate results into a learning note and product/content hypotheses without automatic changes.
skills.stopCondition: Do not compare raw customer data across tenants or change product, prompt, price or audience automatically.
